records.name: input_auxiliary_chains
records.command: for c in ipsec_vpn anti_attack SCL_IP_FILTER_ACCEPT SCL_IP_ACCEPT SCL_IP_DROP upnp_blacklist dhcp_lanportmap secondary_lan_in dhcp_relay gre_tunnel l2tp_tunnel; do iptables -S "$c" 2>/dev/null; done | awk '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++)if($i=="-s"||$i=="-d")$(i+1)="[address withheld]";print}'
records.output:
-N ipsec_vpn
-N anti_attack
-A anti_attack -i br0 -j RETURN
-A anti_attack -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags SYN,ACK SYN -m hashlimit --hashlimit-above 30/sec --hashlimit-burst 30 --hashlimit-name syncookies -j ANTI_TARGET
-A anti_attack -p udp -m udp --dport 7 -j ANTI_TARGET
-A anti_attack -p udp -m udp --dport 19 -j ANTI_TARGET
-A anti_attack -s [address withheld] ! -i lo -j ANTI_TARGET
-A anti_attack -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags FIN,SYN FIN,SYN -j ANTI_TARGET
-A anti_attack -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN,RST -j ANTI_TARGET
-A anti_attack -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags FIN,RST FIN,RST -j ANTI_TARGET
-A anti_attack -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags FIN,ACK FIN -j ANTI_TARGET

-A anti_attack -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags ACK,URG URG -j ANTI_TARGET
-A anti_attack -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags FIN,SYN,RST,PSH,ACK,URG NONE -j ANTI_TARGET
-A anti_attack -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags FIN,SYN,RST,PSH,ACK,URG FIN,SYN,RST,PSH,ACK,URG -j ANTI_TARGET
-A anti_attack -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags FIN,SYN,RST,PSH,ACK,URG FIN,SYN,RST,ACK,URG -j ANTI_TARGET
-A anti_attack -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags FIN,SYN,RST,PSH,ACK,URG FIN -j ANTI_TARGET
-A anti_attack -p tcp -m tcp --tcp-flags FIN,SYN,RST,PSH,ACK,URG FIN,PSH,URG -j ANTI_TARGET
-N SCL_IP_FILTER_ACCEPT
-A SCL_IP_FILTER_ACCEPT -j SCL_IP_ACCEPT
-N SCL_IP_ACCEPT
-N SCL_IP_DROP
-N upnp_blacklist
-N dhcp_lanportmap
-N secondary_lan_in
-N dhcp_relay
-A dhcp_relay -p udp -m udp --dport 67 -j ACCEPT
-N gre_tunnel
